integrity: The exact simplicial collapse is proved for every positive page count and every subgroup of its page-permutation action. Finite code checks provide corroboration only. No independent external scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion applies only to coherent directed three-cycles sharing a single arrow, with exactly the specified arc set; it does not address bidirected books, longer pages, or other digraphs. Unindexed equivalent literature is possible.
title: Equivariant collapse of consistently oriented triangular-book multipath complexes
